relationships.subject: JWH133
relationships.evidence_quote: JWH133 binds with greater affinity to CB2R than CB1R and acts as a potent CB2R-selective agonist

relationships.subject: JWH133
relationships.evidence_quote: JWH133 significantly decreased MMP-9 content in ApoE2/2 mouse aortic root and carotid plaques

relationships.subject: JWH133
relationships.evidence_quote: JWH133 also decreased OxLDL-induced TNF-α and reactive oxygen species (ROS) production and blocked RhoA GTPase stimulation.

relationships.subject: JWH133
relationships.evidence_quote: CB2R stimulation by JWH133 boosted IL-10 release from LPS/IFN-γ-stimulated macrophages.

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: indicating that TRPV1 is necessary for CB2R-mediated activity

key_findings: Review: JWH133 is a CB2R-selective agonist (~200-fold over CB1R) with anti-inflammatory, antioxidant and antiapoptotic effects outside the nervous system.
JWH133 reduces TNF-alpha-driven ERK1/2 signaling, MMP-9 release and RhoA activation in vascular and immune cells.
